(2) Semantics: the state space coherently tracks the siren (uS/uCS/uDS/uFS roles), the pot cycle (uC/uCS = boiling with item carried, uD/uDS = boiling with hands empty after the put-down, uR/uRS = post-fix pickup pending), and the slip clause (uF). (4) Reward safety: all rewards are tied to count-limited environment events (serves, rings, boils, orders, slips), bounded and dense; the fall (-0.3) plus immediate-pickup (+0.3) pair nets zero for compliant behavior and -0.8 for a missed 'very next move' pickup, matching the task's one-step constraint; no exploit loop exists (deliberate drops produce no food_fell and no reward). (5) Pot regressions are explicit: put-down is tracked (uC/uCS to uD/uDS), fix pays +0.6, and taking the item up again pays +0.3 via uR/uRS, including when siren and boil overlap. (6) Irrelevant propositions (client_arrived, served_while_ringing) and no-op toggles are absorbed by else self-loops with zero reward. Minor non-blocking notes: condition-only transitions (e.g., (u0, siren_ringing & pot_boiling & holding_food) -> uCS) omit explicit 0.0 reward entries (default zero is unambiguous here); a few !siren_ringing branches in uS/uC/uCS are unreachable defensive fallbacks; the uC/uCS/uD/uDS names suggest client tracking but actually denote pot-carry states — cosmetic only. food_fell taking precedence over a co-occurring order_taken/food_prepared (forgoing a small shaping reward) is consistent with the task's hard immediate-pickup priority.
